name: opponent_knight_on_rim
description: Opponent has at least one knight on the edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank).
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'opponent_knight_on_rim'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Opponent has at least one knight on the edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank).'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, opp):
        if chess.square_file(sq) in (0, 7) or chess.square_rank(sq) in (0, 7):
            return True
    return False
